preregistration_deviation.reason: All fourteen lineages admitted before the first behavioral run were retained; none was replaced or removed after outcomes were observed.

selection_rule: A held-out probe author may instantiate one or more frozen templates only from a public task schema, evaluator specification, or cross-entrypoint contract visible in a parent-only packet. If no template applies without the fix diff, the lineage is recorded as undetected.

preconditions: Two encodings denote the same value under an independently published schema or language semantics.
The transformation does not add, remove, or change task-relevant information.
templates.transformation: Replace one admissible representation with another contract-equivalent representation.
templates.oracle: The deterministic verdict or terminal graded state is identical for both representations.
prohibited_adaptations: Choosing a representation pair from the fix diff.
Treating approximate semantic similarity as equivalence.
Normalizing the grader source.

preconditions: Two documented entrypoints or modes evaluate the same stored or live execution.
Any mode-specific state representation is preserved.
templates.transformation: Evaluate the same semantic execution through the paired entrypoints or documented modes.
templates.oracle: The component set, terminal state, and deterministic reward agree up to explicitly documented mode-specific fields.
prohibited_adaptations: Injecting a mode marker not present in the graded artifact.
Dropping a reward component to obtain agreement.
Selecting an entrypoint pair only after observing the fix.

preconditions: The added action or state field is documented as read-only, observational, or irrelevant to the scored task.
templates.transformation: Add, remove, or vary only the independently irrelevant action or state component.
templates.oracle: The task-relevant terminal state and verdict remain unchanged.
prohibited_adaptations: Calling a state mutation benign without a public contract.
Ignoring a changed task-relevant field.
Using the fixed implementation to define irrelevance.

preconditions: The contract requires every submitted item or call to satisfy the same criterion.
Items can be varied independently while preserving response validity.
templates.transformation: Add, duplicate, permute, or invalidate one item while holding all other items fixed.
templates.oracle: Acceptance is invariant to benign cardinality changes and becomes rejection when any required item is invalid.
prohibited_adaptations: Using a special item count from the historical fix.
Changing multiple item values in one diagnostic case.
Treating order as irrelevant when the contract makes it meaningful.

preconditions: The public schema distinguishes the valid and invalid input types or structures.
The adapter is part of the evaluation path rather than model-facing prompt construction.
templates.transformation: Change one valid field into a schema-invalid value while retaining the surrounding response.
templates.oracle: The invalid response stays distinguishable and cannot become accepted through evaluator-side coercion.
prohibited_adaptations: Inferring the invalid type from the fix.
Changing the prompt or model input.
Counting parser failure as correct rejection without a deterministic verdict.

preconditions: Each evaluation succeeds in a fresh process or isolated invocation.
templates.transformation: Execute the same evaluations sequentially in both orders within the supported worker boundary.
templates.oracle: Each verdict equals its isolated verdict regardless of order.
prohibited_adaptations: Resetting undocumented global state between sequential cases.
Using process restart as the tested treatment.
Selecting colliding identifiers from the fix diff.

preconditions: The task semantics are explicitly relative to the evaluated environment.
Host and target environment context can be varied independently.
templates.transformation: Change the target environment context while holding the grader host context fixed, then reverse the control.
templates.oracle: The verdict follows the documented target context and is invariant to irrelevant host context.
prohibited_adaptations: Using wall-clock time without a frozen clock.
Calling host context irrelevant when the task specifies it.
Reading context-selection logic from the fix.

preconditions: The primary helper artifact is optional or derivative.
An independently documented source exposes the same canonical state.
templates.transformation: Remove the optional helper artifact while preserving the equivalent canonical state source.
templates.oracle: Evaluation recovers the same state and verdict, or fails only when both equivalent sources are absent.
prohibited_adaptations: Inventing a fallback not documented by the environment.
Writing the missing helper before evaluation.
Selecting the fallback path from the fix diff.
